answer: Each identity joins a four-member mutual pool, locking an 80-credit bond; roster and bonds sit on a ledger anyone can recount, so no bond serves two pools. A raven auditor splits a member's record into funding, receipts, and endorsements matching the ledger, filing a sonnet report on any mismatch. If one member is proven false, the 320-credit pool bond burns. The kth fake needs its own 80-credit bond: 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits across 250 pools. A funding comet fails: pools fed from one source flare on the ledger and are audited first. An honest agent joins one pool and locks one bond.
